by_cases h0 : U = 0
· simp [h0, le_of_lt (mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hB _))]
have hUp : 0 < U := lt_of_le_of_ne hU (Ne.symm h0)
have h := mul_le_mul (Real.rpow_le_rpow hU hUA (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1)) (Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg hU hq.le) hUB hs) (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hU hq.le) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hA.le _)
calc
 U / q^s = U^(1-s)*(U/q)^s := by
  rw [Real.div_rpow hU hq.le]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hUp]
  congr 1
  rw [sub_add_cancel, Real.rpow_one]
 _ ≤ A^(1-s)*B^s := h
